text: I do not need this right now, but I am interested next month. Please tell me the current price; do not book anything or call this a permanent rejection.

That is completely fine, we can help you next month as well. A basic service is four hundred ninety nine rupees and a puncture repair is one hundred twenty rupees, with parts extra only after approval. Would you like me to note down your details for an enquiry later?
Yes, I am still interested in future. I am not asking you to call me later right now. What should I know about the service?
Parts are extra only after approval, and we are open Tuesday to Sunday from 9 AM to 6 PM. Would you like to share your name and locality so we can keep your enquiry on record?
You have answered my questions. I do not need anything else. Goodbye, end the call.
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
